<!--
How to write this description (people and agents alike):
- Write for a reviewer who has read only the title. Give what the diff cannot: why, effect, risk.
- Every line carries information. Delete a section rather than leave it empty or write "N/A".
- No list of changed files, no restating the diff, no summary of the summary, no filler
  ("This PR…", "comprehensive", "robust", "seamlessly").
- No links to agent threads or sessions (ampcode.com, claude.ai), no "Generated with…" lines,
  no agent credited as author or co-author. Crediting humans is fine.
- Aim for under 150 words. A one-line fix can be one line under Why.
- Delete these comments.
-->

## Why

<!-- The problem or need, in 1–3 sentences. Link the issue if there is one. -->

## What changes

<!-- Effects on users, operators or other code, as bullets. Not a file list.
     Name any decision a reviewer might question, and why you made it. -->

## Verification

<!-- What you ran or checked, and what it showed: tests added, commands, manual steps,
     screenshots for UI. Say what you did NOT verify. -->

## Risk and follow-ups

<!-- Only if there are any: migrations, configuration or environment changes, security boundaries
     (docs/security.md), self-hosting impact, the mobile app (CI skips it), API breaking changes,
     known gaps, work left for later. -->
